in_sanskrit.name: Sohel
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun, Bright, Shining
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sohel एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। From the Sanskrit word ‘Soham’, meaning ‘I am the Sun’. This name is associated with the radiant and bright nature of the Sun, and the light it brings into one's life.

in_hindi.name: Sohel
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun, Bright, Shining
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sohel एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। From the Sanskrit word ‘Soham’, meaning ‘I am the Sun’. This name is associated with the radiant and bright nature of the Sun, and the light it brings into one's life.

in_tamil.name: Sohel
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Sun, Bright, Shining

in_telugu.name: Sohel
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Sun, Bright, Shining

in_marathi.name: Sohel
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun, Bright, Shining
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sohel हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit word ‘Soham’, meaning ‘I am the Sun’. This name is associated with the radiant and bright nature of the Sun, and the light it brings into one's life.
